invariants.invariant: Library, tests, and declaration-build TypeScript programs agree without suppressions or generated declaration holes.
invariants.oracle: Run the three project graphs and verify every public entry resolves to emitted declarations built from the same entry authority.
bites: Remove one public return member from its declaration.
Insert an expect-error that no longer suppresses a real error.

invariants.invariant: A clean build emits a self-contained package whose files, CSS URLs, maps, and declaration imports all resolve inside the packed artifact.
invariants.oracle: Build in a clean output directory, npm-pack it, unpack elsewhere, parse every CSS URL and declaration import, and import every entry.
bites: Delete one packed CSS asset.
Point one emitted declaration at a source-only path.

invariants.invariant: One entry graph generates Vite inputs, declarations, package exports, types, and migration mappings; no hand mirror or source subpath barrel exists.
invariants.oracle: Generate each projection in memory and compare semantic maps, then resolve every key from the packed artifact.
bites: Add a package export absent from the authority.
Restore one src/subpaths mirror barrel.

invariants.invariant: Runtime, peer, optional, and development dependencies match actual import boundaries and the supported package contract.
invariants.oracle: Parse import graphs and package metadata; reject undeclared runtime imports, unused peer surfaces, source file links in release, and duplicate semantic engines.
bites: Move a runtime dependency to devDependencies.
Add a second spring engine for an existing motion concept.

invariants.invariant: The execution branch, ROOT canon commit, source-base commit, and wave commits form one declared lineage with no retrospective or duplicate wave attribution.
invariants.oracle: Walk first-parent Git subjects and committed receipts; require exactly one terminal commit for every DONE or evidence-backed DEAD wave, forbid either outcome from sharing a commit, and require pre-implementation plan timestamps. A DEAD receipt never unlocks a dependent, and P002 DEAD withdraws the entire execution lineage.
bites: Assign one commit to two waves.
Move the ROOT canon pointer without renewing conformance.

invariants.invariant: Disk cursor and git make wave execution exactly-once across restart; only terminal waves unlock dependents.
invariants.oracle: Replay state reconstruction from fixtures covering RUNNING crash, integrated-before-cursor crash, no-op, DEAD, and stale worktree.
bites: Make a RUNNING wave runnable after restart.
Let a no-op remain without DONE/DEAD disposition.

invariants.invariant: The active graph is acyclic, subject-complete, transitively reduced, resource-lock schedulable, and contains no ceremony-only tail.
invariants.oracle: Validate schema, compute transitive reduction, simulate locks, identify proof-only leaves, and require every accepted obligation to map exactly once.
bites: Add a transitive edge.
Add a LAST wave whose only subject is rerunning already-owned evidence.

invariants.invariant: FINAL, version, changelog, migration, tarball, verifier evidence, π evidence, and tag all describe the exact same terminal source tree.
invariants.oracle: Generate release projection from cursor; compare hashes and reject missing/nonterminal/older evidence before tag creation.
bites: Change package version without projection regeneration.
Use a π artifact from the parent commit.

invariants.invariant: Every public component concept has one flat family home; ui/custom tiers, public wrapper synonyms, and second authorities are absent.
invariants.oracle: Build an AST component/export graph, classify concept IDs, and enforce one home plus explicit private parts.
bites: Restore src/components/ui.
Export IconTooltip beside Tooltip.

invariants.invariant: Imports flow through declared public family or private owner boundaries without nested source entrypoints, cycles, or alias-dependent package behavior.
invariants.oracle: Parse the TS/Vue/CSS graph, compute SCCs, and resolve package-vs-source boundaries.
bites: Import a sibling family's internal file.
Create an SCC between motion and glass.

invariants.invariant: No legacy alias, deprecated prop, compatibility shim, dual read/write, silent masking path, or retired public name survives.
invariants.oracle: AST and semantic registries enumerate aliases/props/tokens/exports; allow only classified capability, accessibility, SSR, or initial-value paths.
bites: Re-export Countup as an alias.
Read both variant and morphT for the same blob state.

invariants.invariant: Production source explains current invariants without tranche IDs, recovery diaries, retired alternatives, or migration archaeology.
invariants.oracle: Comment-aware scanner permits API rationale and external standards, rejects historical wave/tranche narratives and compatibility promises.
bites: Add a BI.W identifier to src.
Describe a retired implementation as current rationale.

invariants.invariant: Every semantic token has one definition, typed domain, live consumer, valid dark/contrast resolution, and no alias cycle or dead rung.
invariants.oracle: Parse CSS custom-property definitions/reads and typed token manifests as a graph; resolve computed values in representative roots.
bites: Create a token alias cycle.
Add a defined token with no computed consumer.

invariants.invariant: Content field, elevated content surface, functional glass, and transient overlay remain perceptually ordered in light/dark and simple/complex backdrops.
invariants.oracle: Measure luminance separation, edge contrast, blur/lensing response, and occlusion across enrolled composited scenes; compare ordering, not a screenshot hash.
bites: Give a content card the same translucency as navigation glass.
Remove overlay edge separation on a complex backdrop.

invariants.invariant: Text, icons, focus, selection, and nontext boundaries meet their semantic contrast requirements in every material and state.
invariants.oracle: Compute foreground/background through composited scenes and run accessibility assertions across light/dark and interactive states.
bites: Lower selected-control icon contrast below its required band.
Remove the noncolor focus boundary.

invariants.invariant: Reduced transparency, increased contrast, forced colors, and reduced motion remain complete product states with visible hierarchy and semantics.
invariants.oracle: Run the rendered story matrix under each media/emulation mode and assert state visibility, focus, and material replacement behavior.
bites: Leave text on transparent glass under reduced transparency.
Use color alone for forced-colors selection.

invariants.invariant: Display, heading, body, label, code, and numeric rungs are optically distinct, geometrically stable during font load, and never arbitrarily re-minted by a component.
invariants.oracle: Measure computed type roles, line wrapping, font-swap geometry, hierarchy inversions, and overflow at narrow/wide widths.
bites: Set a label larger than its section heading.
Remove size-adjust from the loading fallback and induce layout shift.

invariants.invariant: Interactive, selected, disabled, destructive, draggable, and static states remain distinguishable without relying on color alone.
invariants.oracle: Exercise state transitions and compare cursor/focus/geometry/label/material signals across the rendered component roster.
bites: Make a static Badge visually identical to a Button.
Remove the noncolor selected indicator.

invariants.invariant: Components reflow without hidden controls, unintended overflow, or sub-floor touch targets at supported narrow/wide and coarse/fine inputs.
invariants.oracle: Sweep semantic breakpoints and input modes; measure reachable targets, scroll containers, overlap, and focus order.
bites: Reduce a primary coarse target below the product floor.
Hide a control at narrow width without an equivalent path.

invariants.invariant: Each animated property and semantic episode has one active temporal authority and one writer; physics playback, continuous fields, render loops, native/CSS timelines, one-shot coalescers, and discrete semantic timers use their declared lifecycle owner without overlap or orphan work.
invariants.oracle: AST plus runtime instrumentation classifies ownership by mechanism and property, then proves pause, settle, interruption, offscreen behavior, and teardown; raw callback counts, one global scheduler, and a keyframes import are never success evidence.
bites: Add a component-local rAF writer for a transform already controlled by engine playback.
Keep a native/CSS timeline and JS shadow writer active on the same property.
Let a discrete typing timer or one-shot coalescer survive cancellation/teardown.

invariants.invariant: Press, selection, morph, dock, and route motion draw from one named spring vocabulary and settle without overshoot/magnitude anomalies.
invariants.oracle: Record temporal geometry samples and fit them to declared families with behavior bands, not exact frame snapshots.
bites: Use an arbitrary cubic-bezier for a spring-owned press.
Double dock overshoot beyond its family band.

invariants.invariant: Enter, exit, reorder, route, and shared-element transitions preserve identity, focus, and spatial continuity without layout flashing.
invariants.oracle: Capture geometry/focus/state trajectories through named transitions and assert continuity and final ownership.
bites: Unmount the source before the shared destination is measurable.
Lose focus during a dialog-to-page transition.

invariants.invariant: Scroll-linked effects are bounded to the owning scroller, preserve input responsiveness, and use native timelines where supported without a shadow writer.
invariants.oracle: Instrument scroll timelines/writers and sample progress monotonicity, scroller ownership, main-thread work, and unsupported-path behavior.
bites: Attach a document listener for a component scroller.
Run JS progress writes while a native timeline is active.

invariants.invariant: Reduced motion removes travel, continuous oscillation, and nonessential delay while preserving state change and focus causality.
invariants.oracle: Exercise every enrolled transition under PRM and assert final state, latency, and absence of continuous animation/travel.
bites: Keep a breathing loop active under PRM.
Suppress the selected-state change along with its animation.

invariants.invariant: Dialog, drawer, popover, menu, tooltip, and toast honor their distinct APG roles, focus, dismissal, modality, and announcement contracts over shared infrastructure.
invariants.oracle: Keyboard/pointer/touch scenarios assert role/state/focus stack/escape/outside-click and announcement semantics per concept.
bites: Give a tooltip dialog semantics.
Let Escape close the wrong stacked overlay.

invariants.invariant: Form controls preserve labels, descriptions, errors, required/invalid state, keyboard editing, and native submission semantics.
invariants.oracle: Render every form family in valid/invalid/disabled/read-only states and exercise keyboard, pointer, touch, and form submission.
bites: Detach a Select error from aria-describedby.
Prevent NumberField native form value submission.

invariants.invariant: Tabs, toggles, chips, radio, checkbox, and selectable lists expose the correct independent/exclusive selection semantics and roving focus.
invariants.oracle: Exercise selection models, orientation, Home/End/arrows, form state, and selected visual signals.
bites: Expose aria-pressed on a tab.
Allow an exclusive group to hold two values.

invariants.invariant: Dock layers, selection, overflow, morph, escape, focus, context, and reserved layout form one deterministic state machine across rail and bottom modes.
invariants.oracle: Drive the public state machine through keyboard/pointer/touch, verify geometry, focus, and layer ownership, and detect duplicated engines.
bites: Open two exclusive dock layers.
Let a rail selection push a route during hydration.

invariants.invariant: Tables, data tables, metrics, progress, timeline, and virtual lists preserve semantic structure, stable identity, readable density, and truthful loading/empty/error state.
invariants.oracle: Exercise sort/select/virtualize/update states and inspect semantic tables/rows/metrics plus painted alignment.
bites: Use array index as a row identity.
Announce indeterminate progress as a false percentage.

invariants.invariant: Alert, notification, toast, badge, status, pulse, skeleton, and progress communicate distinct urgency/liveness without color-only or perpetual-motion ambiguity.
invariants.oracle: Run state and announcement scenarios; compare semantic roles, lifetime, motion, labels, and visual hierarchy.
bites: Give a decorative Pulse assertive live-region semantics.
Make error and success badges differ only by hue.

invariants.invariant: Focus order, focus visibility, containment, restoration, and Escape ownership remain correct across every interactive composition.
invariants.oracle: Traverse rendered routes and nested overlays using keyboard-only scenarios; assert the central focus/escape stack.
bites: Restore focus to a removed trigger.
Hide the focus ring on glass.

invariants.invariant: Every GPU/Canvas scene composes one shared mount/resize/DPR/visibility/error lifecycle and releases resources deterministically.
invariants.oracle: Instrument adapters and lifecycle events in fake/device contexts; reject private observer/resize/rAF forks and leaked handles.
bites: Create a scene-local ResizeObserver lifecycle.
Leave a GPU buffer alive after unmount.

invariants.invariant: WebGPU-preferred and supported WebGL2 paths express the same scene identity, configuration semantics, color space, and interaction within declared perceptual bands.
invariants.oracle: Render seeded configurations on both engines, compare geometry/color/statistics and behavior; expose engine identity and hard failure.
bites: Interpret a config scalar differently in GLSL and WGSL.
Silently render an unrelated Canvas2D scene after both GPU engines fail.

invariants.invariant: Procedural scenes resolve CSS/OKLCh inputs through one linear-light pipeline with bounded gamut handling and no duplicate OETF or premultiplication error.
invariants.oracle: Run analytic color vectors and painted readbacks across engines, themes, and alpha composites.
bites: Apply sRGB encoding twice.
Interpolate OKLCh hue through the long arc unintentionally.

invariants.invariant: Pointer/touch/keyboard/config interaction changes a scene deliberately, remains bounded, and preserves a calm default plus PRM behavior.
invariants.oracle: Drive seeded scenes and compare response magnitude, containment, settle, touch equivalence, and PRM freeze/state.
bites: Let pointer velocity eject a blob satellite from containment.
Keep autonomous turbulence moving under PRM.

invariants.invariant: Supported routes meet interaction, loading, layout stability, long-task, memory, and frame-pacing budgets under representative hardware profiles without hiding work.
invariants.oracle: Collect traces and distributions over named scenarios; compare against product budgets and prior accepted distributions, not one magic snapshot.
bites: Eager-load every procedural renderer on the landing route.
Move work into an unmeasured post-load timer.

invariants.invariant: A route owns only the observers, contexts, event listeners, and timers required by rendered concepts, and teardown returns to baseline.
invariants.oracle: Instrument creation/teardown and correlate handles with rendered owners across navigation cycles.
bites: Leak a window listener across route exit.
Create two WebGL contexts for one rendered scene.

invariants.invariant: Every story exposes the states required to evaluate its behavior, material, responsiveness, accessibility, and reduced-motion contract through reusable chassis.
invariants.oracle: Discover scenario metadata and execute state controls; reject decorative controls that do not alter the claimed property.
bites: Add a dark-mode control that changes no rendered subtree.
Omit invalid state from a form story.

invariants.invariant: The demo reads as one intentional product: warm field, functional glass, audacious typographic hierarchy, restrained color, and concept-driven motion without page-local design forks.
invariants.oracle: Evaluate composited whole-route properties and cross-route consistency using structural metrics plus fresh human design review; never screenshot equality.
bites: Restore a generic teal-gradient hero on one route.
Give every card an independent glow and pill title.

invariants.invariant: Every in-scope sibling acceptance names the exact package tarball, owner commit, import scan, build/test evidence, and required π evidence; no retired import remains and no foreign write originates here.
invariants.oracle: Compare owner packets/cursor receipts with read-only tracked-source scans, tarball digest, and before/after sibling status snapshots.
bites: Accept a consumer against a different tarball digest.
Count an uncommitted foreign patch as adoption.
